data.one_liner: A validation library for official and unofficial IBANs.
data.what_it_does: It validates International Bank Account Numbers (IBANs) from the official registry and supports some unofficial ones. It also formats IBANs into standard electronic or print-friendly formats.
use_when: You need to validate bank account IBAN inputs in your app forms.
You need to format IBANs into electronic or print-friendly layouts.
avoid_when: You need broader payment gateway integration or processing rather than simple string validation.
strengths: Supports a wide range of official and unofficial country specifications.
Provides sanitization and formatting utilities out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited to IBAN validation and formatting tasks only.
